description: Release 1 round 3, acceptance check 4: /immersive builds its AudioContext before the first paint instead of inside the click on Enable Sound & Start. Sorts after PG-perf3 / PG-core, whose texts these anchor on.

patches.find: const responses = await Promise.all(PLACEMENT_FILES.map(f => fetch('/data/' + f).then(r => r.json())));
patches.note: check 4 (input matrix) on Chrome 156: the click on 'Enable Sound & Start' was one task of 292-389 ms on desktop and phone (limit 50 ms, response limit 100 ms) because the first AudioContext of the session is built inside it; the cost depends on the machine and the moment (45-300 ms measured here). The context is now built in the first task of the page, before the first paint (where a long task is not blocking time and the placement downloads run alongside).

the click takes the context built at load, resumes it (a context built without a user action starts suspended) and builds the sound graph (a few ms); a browser that refused the early context still builds it here as before.
